subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The code now matches the requested shape, but deciding that active model-call stalls may use idle-timeout fallback while side-effecting tool stalls may not is an agent/session policy choice.

options.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

options.title: Require broader proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until broader runtime proof covers more model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run paths against current main.

options.title: Pause for recovery timing
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the cron recovery-timing path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 to settle first.

recommendation.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
recommendation.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already stated the replay-safety requirement this PR is trying to satisfy.
